input.command: cd site && ls css && grep -n "orders" -r *.html | head; grep -n -B2 -A4 "th\b\|td\b" css/*.css
grep -n "space-[0-9]:" css/tokens.css; grep -ln 'class="table' *.html; grep -n "table" css/pages.css; sed -n 466,520p css/components.css | grep -n -A3 "table\|td"

cd css && python3 - <<'E'
s=open('components.css').read()
a=".table tbody tr:last-child td {"
s=s.replace(a,".page-orders .table td {\n  padding-top: 6px;\n  padding-bottom: 6px;\n}\n\n"+a,1)
open('components.css','w').write(s)
E
cd ../.. && npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts 2>&1 | tail -15

I haven't looked at the diff images themselves. If the shorter orders pages look right to you, I can approve the two orders baselines. You can also run `npx testivai approve orders__desktop orders__phone` yourself.
